purpose: D7: machine-readable contracts future maintainers execute against

reference_manifest.update_rule: changing any pin = new release candidate + re-run of the CPU suite + a GPU smoke (first song) + pilot regression before any claim extends to the new pin

supported_version_policy.supported: exactly the pinned reference stack (see reference manifest)
supported_version_policy.policy: one verified stack at a time; anything else is UNSUPPORTED_CONFIGURATION (the verify tool says so)

update_upstream_pin: 1. freeze the new upstream head SHA (PR #42106 head, never the merge ref)
2. diff-review source files that the runtime touches (02_UPSTREAM_DELTA_REVIEW.md precedent)
5. GPU smoke (first song) + pilot 5x2 + hash-compare vs frozen campaign
6. only then extend any claim; the 384-campaign validation NEVER auto-extends
procedures.test_new_rocm_release: install into a FRESH venv (never mutate the pinned one) -> doctor --check-torch -> GPU identity -> first song -> pilot -> compare
procedures.test_new_radeon_gpu: doctor (arch detection) -> if arch outside the verified matrix: UNSUPPORTED_CONFIGURATION; else first song + pilot + verify; record PHYSICAL_PASS only with receipts
procedures.detect_metric_drift: re-run verify + compare against the frozen scoreboard; any delta outside disclosed arms = investigate before publishing (never average arms)
procedures.reproduce_reported_failure: reference status -> gpu_lock state -> run the same command with the same pins -> journals/receipts carry identity chains; scorer failures now raise ScorerValidationError with explicit reasons
procedures.contribute_patches: UPSTREAM_PATCH_OWNERSHIP.md per-issue plan: problem + minimal reproducer + patch + hardware receipt; no mega-PRs; no un-authorized external filing
procedures.add_benchmark_evidence: new run_id + new directory (never write frozen trees) + tier receipt + scoreboard update only after full coverage

ci_policy.cpu_ci: required on every HEAD (tests/ + guards + compileall + bash -n); documents what it is NOT: no GPU execution
ci_policy.gpu_smoke_acceptance: manual/owner-triggered (first song + identity + pilot); requires the physical rig
ci_policy.optional_benchmark_pilot: opt-in, long-running; pilot numbers NEVER compared with full numbers
ci_policy.rule: CPU CI green is never presented as GPU validation
